name: XInsFullMotorCasco
caption: Əlavə modullar / Sığorta / Tam avto KASKO

datasets.name: Ins_MotorFull
datasets.sql: select /*+ index(ins_motorfull INS_IDX_FULL) */im.rowid,im.* from ins_motorfull im WHERE CLOSE_PREFIX=0 ORDER BY  :title

datasets.name: Accesories
datasets.sql:
select im.rowid,im.* from ins_motor_accesories im

where full_id = :full_id

datasets.name: MoreThanOne
datasets.sql:
select im.rowid,im.* from INS_MOTORMORETHANONEDRIVER im

where full_id = :full_id

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.id,c.name||' '||c.surname||' '||c.fathername as name,c.address,c.mobilephone,c.fax,c.contactperson from ins_customers c

datasets.name: Ins_Report
datasets.sql:
select id, PINS_FullMotor.returnName(kli_id) as name,Pins_FullMotor.returnAddress(kli_id) as Address,Pins_FullMotor.returnPhone(kli_id) as phone,pins_fullmotor.returnFax(kli_id) as fax,contact_person, banking_details,
       profitid,insuredmodel,insuredtype,
       insuredstatenum, insuredcolor,insuredoutputyear,
      insurednumseats,insuredenginenum,insuredchassisnum,
      insuredactualvalue,transmission_type,presence_alarm,
      motor_usage,motorstorageplace,existingdamage,insurancegeographicallimit
 from ins_motorfull

datasets.name: Accesories_Report
datasets.sql:
select im.* from ins_motor_accesories im

where full_id = :full_id

datasets.name: More_Report
datasets.sql: select id,full_id,name||'  '||surname||'  '||fathername as name,age,experience,history from INS_MOTORMORETHANONEDRIVER where full_id = :full_id

datasets.name: Suggestion
datasets.sql:
select s.rowid,s.* from ins_mf_suggestion s
where mk_id = :mk_id

datasets.name: BankInfo
datasets.sql: select *from BankInfo

datasets.name: AValute
datasets.sql: select valute, val_name, valu_name, valu_short from avalute

datasets.name: Policy

select imp.rowid, imp.* from ins_mf_policy imp
where imp.ms_id= :ms_id

       insuredmodel,insuredtype,
